channel.title: Marcu curated AI feed
channel.description: No algorithm, no ads; interest graph from his bookmarks corpus plus local-model judgment.

item.title: The regulation of local AI could/should be viewed as the largest censorship implementation in the history of mankind.
item.description: With all of this fear mongering on the “dangers” of LLM’s, I see how using people’s ignorance and emotions on the subject can be used as a tool to limit and restrict the tool from the average person.
